April 19, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy 
W-G Shaheen & Associates Dba Whitney & Co increased its stake in Aflac Inc (AFL) by 6.82% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 56,670 shares of the accident &health insurance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.97 million, up from 53,053 at the end of the previous reported quarter. W-G Shaheen & Associates Dba Whitney & Co who had been investing in Aflac Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $35.29B market cap company.
